descriptionChirho: Distal demonstrative pronoun pointing to a more remote referent, 'that one, the one yonder.' Translated as English 'that,' Spanish 'aquel/aquella,' Hindi 'vah' (वह), Arabic 'dhalika' (ذَلِكَ), Korean 'jeogi' (저기/저쪽), Swahili 'yule/kile.' Used to single out a person or thing already known or at a distance from the speaker in biblical narrative contexts.

Proximal demonstrative pronoun indicating a nearer referent, 'this one, this.' Includes dative-directional uses with preposition lamed ('to this one'). Translated as English 'this/this one,' Spanish 'este/a este,' Hindi 'is/ise' (इस/इसे), Arabic 'hadha' (هٰذَا/هَذَا), Korean 'i' (이/이자에게), Swahili 'huyu/huu.' Covers both standalone and prepositional constructions of the same proximal meaning.
